items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original Japanese N4 listening exam 03 question3-01. Create a square black-and-white educational line illustration on white, clear at phone size. Inside a train, a seated young male passenger offers his seat with an open palm to an elderly woman standing beside him holding a walking cane. Both full upper bodies and seat visible. Polite natural gestures, simple uncluttered background. No text, numbers, logos, speech bubbles or answer marks.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original N4 exam03 listening3-02. Square black-and-white clean educational line drawing on white, readable at phone size. A female student in a library reaches for a single book on a high bookshelf, her fingertips clearly below the book, unable to reach. An adult male librarian stands nearby, facing her attentively. Frame the upper shelf, book, student's raised arm, and librarian clearly. Plain book spines with no writing. No words, numbers, logos, speech bubbles, arrows or answer markers.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original N4 exam03 listening3-03. Square black-and-white educational line illustration, white background and clear phone-size outlines. Show three normal buttons and one conspicuously empty button position with loose threads on the front placket. Customer points to that missing button. Shirt is large enough to see the defect, both people polite and calm. No words, numbers, labels, logos, speech bubbles or answer markers.
